Weighted Distance calculation

Source: R/compat.R, R/distance.R
weighted_distance.Rd

Computes \(d(x_i, y_j) = \sum_k |w_k (x_{ik} - y_{jk})|\).

Usage

weightedDistance(x, y = NULL, weights = NULL)

weighted_distance(x, y = NULL, weights = NULL)

Arguments

x

a numeric matrix

y

a second numeric matrix with the same columns as x (default: NULL, pairwise distances within x)

weights

a vector of weights, one per column (default: all 1)

Value

a dist object (if y is NULL) or a nrow(x) x nrow(y) matrix

Examples

x <- as.matrix(iris[1:5, 1:4])
weighted_distance(x)
#>     1   2   3   4
#> 2 0.7            
#> 3 0.8 0.5        
#> 4 1.0 0.5 0.4    
#> 5 0.2 0.7 0.8 1.0
weighted_distance(x, as.matrix(iris[6:7, 1:4]), weights = c(1, 1, 2, 2))
#>      [,1] [,2]
#> [1,]  1.7  0.8
#> [2,]  2.4  0.9
#> [3,]  2.6  0.7
#> [4,]  2.4  0.7
#> [5,]  1.7  0.8
